overall_goal: Filter out the hibiscus leaves and ginger bits from the drink using a slotted spoon

goals.description: Retrieve and inspect the slotted spoon
goals.rationale: The person fetches a slotted spoon from the drawer and inspects it before placing it on the counter.

goals.description: Scoop out hibiscus and ginger bits from the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person uses the slotted spoon to filter out the solid ingredients from the drink and places them on the saucepan's lid.

goals.description: Continue scooping out hibiscus and ginger bits from the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person continues to sift through the drink with the slotted spoon to remove the remaining discarded flowers and ginger.

goals.description: Prepare the counter and retrieve the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person sets up a napkin and measuring cup on the counter, then moves the saucepan from the hob to the prepared area.
The person looks through a cupboard and a drawer to find a funnel for straining the liquid.

goals.description: Strain the drink into a measuring cup
goals.rationale: The person pours the hibiscus drink from the saucepan into the measuring cup while using the slotted spoon as a filter.

goals.description: Retrieve a Pyrex bowl and strain the drink into it
goals.rationale: The person fetches and rinses a Pyrex bowl, then pours the remaining hibiscus drink into it using the slotted spoon as a sieve.
